differences.title: 1. PERSISTENCE MODEL
differences.leftDesc: RocksDB uses an LSM-tree with multiple levels and write amplification control for optimized write throughput and space amplification. Features bloom filters and block cache.
differences.rightDesc: LevelDB also uses an LSM-tree but with a simpler architecture, focusing on high performance for reads and writes with fewer configuration options for tuning.

differences.title: 2. FEATURES & TUNING
differences.leftDesc: RocksDB offers advanced features like column families, snapshots, atomic batch writes, and comprehensive tuning knobs for diverse workloads and performance optimization.
differences.rightDesc: LevelDB prioritizes ease of use and embedding, providing essential features with fewer knobs, making it ideal for straightforward embedded storage needs.

differences.title: 3. WRITE AMPLIFICATION
differences.leftDesc: RocksDB actively manages compaction strategies, balancing data freshness and storage efficiency to minimize write amplification, crucial for high-volume write scenarios.
differences.rightDesc: LevelDB's compaction is less sophisticated, which can lead to higher write amplification under heavy write loads compared to RocksDB's advanced techniques.

differences.title: 4. READ PERFORMANCE
differences.leftDesc: Leverages bloom filters and block caches effectively, providing excellent read performance even with large datasets, by reducing disk seeks significantly.
differences.rightDesc: Optimized for low-latency reads, LevelDB excels at retrieving individual key-value pairs quickly due to its simpler structure and efficient data access.

differences.title: 5. SPACE AMPLIFICATION
differences.leftDesc: RocksDB's multi-level LSM-tree and intelligent compaction minimize redundant data storage, leading to better space utilization over time.
differences.rightDesc: LevelDB's compaction can result in more redundant data copies, potentially leading to higher space amplification compared to RocksDB's more aggressive optimizations.

differences.title: 6. USE CASES
differences.leftDesc: Ideal for large-scale distributed systems, embedded databases like MyRocks, and applications requiring high write throughput and tunable performance.
differences.rightDesc: Perfect for embedded systems, configuration stores, and scenarios where a lightweight, fast, and simple key-value store is needed.

differences.title: 7. COMMUNITY & ORIGIN
differences.leftDesc: Evolved from LevelDB, RocksDB is actively developed by Meta (Facebook) with a strong focus on production-readiness and advanced features for massive scale.
differences.rightDesc: Developed by Google, LevelDB is known for its simplicity, stability, and broad adoption in various embedded and system-level applications.
